decoded.meaning: FWD{ op=AWAIT, dst=/sensor/temp, FIELD :stats.mem.control, src=/reply-ep } — an AWAIT with a FIELD selector. No field is awaitable, so the terminus answers ERROR{tr::schema::not_found} (0x0031) and never waits (reference/05 §:stats).
decoded.note: A legal frame: the refusal is the terminus's, not the codec's. See description.md.
